name: workface
description: Keeps a long-running agent's working notes through every compaction: briefs the summarizer, re-attaches the notes after the summary, and shows them in a panel you can steer.

color_accent.title: Accent colour
color_accent.description: The tranche name and the owner-note marker. A Claude Code theme key (e.g. success, warning, merged), a terminal colour name (e.g. magenta, cyan), or a hex colour (#ff79c6).

color_sha.title: Commit sha colour
color_sha.description: Commit shas in workface lines. A Claude Code theme key (e.g. success, warning, merged), a terminal colour name (e.g. magenta, cyan), or a hex colour (#ff79c6).

color_code.title: Path and command colour
color_code.description: Backticked paths and commands. A Claude Code theme key (e.g. success, warning, merged), a terminal colour name (e.g. magenta, cyan), or a hex colour (#ff79c6).

color_time.title: Timestamp colour
color_time.description: Log timestamps. A Claude Code theme key (e.g. success, warning, merged), a terminal colour name (e.g. magenta, cyan), or a hex colour (#ff79c6).

color_good.title: Good colour
color_good.description: PASS / pushed / merged, a fresh workface, a line budget with room, new lines, running sessions. A Claude Code theme key (e.g. success, warning, merged), a terminal colour name (e.g. magenta, cyan), or a hex colour (#ff79c6).

color_warn.title: Warning colour
color_warn.description: PREDICTED / NOT pushed / unverified, an ageing workface, commits since it was written, omissions. A Claude Code theme key (e.g. success, warning, merged), a terminal colour name (e.g. magenta, cyan), or a hex colour (#ff79c6).

color_bad.title: Bad colour
color_bad.description: FAIL, a stale workface, a line budget overrun. A Claude Code theme key (e.g. success, warning, merged), a terminal colour name (e.g. magenta, cyan), or a hex colour (#ff79c6).
